text:
ANNERŽI-YE OMMUMI-YE RUZ
Emruz asman-e zendege-ye shoma ba enerji-ye bi-nazir va tahavol-afarin-e mah-e tolid-e shoma roshan shode ast. Hes-e daron-e shoma emruz dar ghavi-tarin halat-e khod qarar darad va mesl-e yek qat-nama-ye dorost, shoma ra be samt-e dorost-e masir-e zendege hodayat mikonad. In ruz baraye shoma fasl-e noyi ast; pas ba aghosh-e baz az tarikiha be samt-e nor va roshani harekat konid. Roh-e shoma emruz amade-ye tajrobe-ye taqator-e jadid va dor-e rikhtan-e kohne-ha ast.

EŞGH VA RABETE-HA
Baraye kasani ke dar rabete hastand, emruz zamin-e khobi ast ta ba sharik-e zendege-ye khod darbare-ye ahdaf va royaha-ye ayaande goft-e-go-ye amiq dashte bashand. Ahsas-e nazdiki va etebar mian-e shoma ooj migirad va har gune sote-fahmi barطرف mishavad. Baraye afraad-e mojarad, kaynat emruz yek ghab-e ziba az eshq-e vaghe-i ra dar masir-e shoma gharar midahad; shayad ba fardi ashna shavid ke rooh-e shoma ra khob beshnasad.

KAR VA KARIYER
Dar mohit-e kar, emruz roze tolid-e ferzat-e talayi ast va zireki-ye shoma hame ra ta'جب zohor khahad dad. Ezafe bar in, agar tarhe ya barname-ye jadidi dar sar darid, emruz behtarin zaman baraye shoro-e an ast zira etminan-e nafs-e shoma dar bala-tarin sath ast. Taghat-e tahamol va tekna-goze-ye shoma dar hal-e moskelat, rafte-rafte be sood-e shoma tamom mishavad va modiran-e shoma tavanayi-ye shoma ra bishtar az pish khahand did.

POOR VA BEREKAT
Vazi-e mali-e shoma emruz dar halat-e mostaghar va ro be roshdi ast, vali behtar ast ke dar kharjd-e kardan kamli mohtat bashid. Emruz momken ast ferzat-e khobi baraye sarmaye-gozari ya afzayesh-e daramad pish biad, vali pish az har gona emza-ye mohem, tamame jonbeha-ye an ra ba deghat baresi konid. Berekate emruz dar nateje-ye sabr va barname-rizi-ye dorost-e gozashte-ye shomast; pas az in nemateha ba sepasgozari estefade konid.

SALAMATI VA ENERJI
Az nazar-e jesmi va rohi, emruz ahsas-e shadabi va ghodrat-e zeyadi mikonid, vali nabayad az esterahat-e kafi ghafel shavid. Varzesh-e sabok, meditsion ya piade-ravi dar havaye azad mitoonad be shoma komak konad ta enerji-ye manfi ra az khod dor konid. Be seda-ye badan-e khod gosh konid va agar niaz be baz-sazi darid, chand daqiqe saket boodan ra be khod hadye dahid.

ERTEBATAT VA MOHIT
Ravabet-e shoma ba dustan va khanevade emruz garm, samimi va por az energy-ye mosbat ast. Yek dust-e ghadimi momken ast ba yek khabar-e khob ya pishnahad-e jaleb shoma ra soorprise konad va ruz-e shoma ra besazad. Hozoor dar goroheha va mehmani-ye koochak mitoonad hal-e del-e shoma ra behtar konad va zehn-e shoma ra az fekrha-ye sakht rahaye dahad.

TAVSIYE-YE RUZ
Emruz be ghodrat-e daroni-ye khod eteminan konid va az taghirat narsid; zira har taghir ya enqelab dar zendege-ye shoma, shoma ra be behtarin نسخe az khodetann nazdik-tar mikonad. Ba shoja'at be jolo beravid.

JAZBIYAT VA JORNIYAT-E RUZ
Adad-e shans: 8
Rang-e shans: Sorkh-e tیره (Bordo) ya Meshki
Borj-e hamahang: Abriz va Saratan
